ai_proposed_position: Adopt 5-tier load classification (CRITICAL, ESSENTIAL, DEFERRABLE, INTERRUPTIBLE, NONCRITICAL) based on consequence of loss rather than academic discipline.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: loads.yaml defines single aggregate demand profile P_load without tiering. No 5-tier classification exists in documented project specs.

ai_proposed_position: CRITICAL loads never auto-shed except in declared CRITICAL_INFRASTRUCTURE_EMERGENCY or BATTERY_EMERGENCY. ESSENTIAL shed after DEFERRABLE/INTERRUPTIBLE. NONCRITICAL shed first. 5-min restoration dwell.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: milp.py and optimizer.yaml implement uniform soft penalty c_unmet = $10,000/kWh for all load. No tiered shedding rules or restoration dwell times implemented.

ai_proposed_position: 100% continuous energy service to CRITICAL loads during NORMAL_OPERATION and FORECAST_DEGRADED modes; best achievable service during declared emergencies.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: Project specs document qualitative goal for high reliability. No numerical 100% continuous service SLA or emergency best-effort policy documented.

ai_proposed_position: 0 kWh unmet CRITICAL load in normal/degraded modes (hard constraint). Bounded operationally in emergencies. Review triggers: 15 min continuous outage or 2 kWh / 30 days. Rejects $10,000/kWh penalty as stakeholder policy.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: milp.py contains $10,000/kWh penalty coefficient (implementation evidence). Review confirms $10,000/kWh is software artifact, not stakeholder policy. 0 kWh constraint and review triggers are unestablished.
numerical_values_proposed: 0 kWh (target), 15 minutes (event trigger), 2 kWh / 30 days (cumulative trigger)

ai_proposed_position: Tiered max continuous interruption: CRITICAL 0s target / 5s max gap; ESSENTIAL 30m; DEFERRABLE 8h (480m); INTERRUPTIBLE 24h (1440m); NONCRITICAL no max.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: optimizer.yaml defines dt = 1.0 hour timestep without inter-step interruption constraints or tier-differentiated outage limits.

ai_proposed_position: Hybrid hard-constraint (normal/degraded) + lexicographic fallback (emergency). Reject single soft penalty scalar objective.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: milp.py baseline uses single scalar objective with soft penalty c_unmet * P_unmet. Proposed hybrid hard + lexicographic formulation is unestablished in code.

ai_proposed_position: Primary metric = liters of diesel consumed. Secondary metrics = runtime hours, start count, fuel expenditure ($). Rejects treating cost or kWh as equivalent to liters.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: diesel.yaml provides quadratic fuel curve (a*P^2 + b*P + c*u) and marginal fuel cost ($0.625/kWh). Specs state qualitative goal to minimize diesel reliance.

ai_proposed_position: Monthly soft operating budget + protected 30-day emergency fuel reserve for CRITICAL+ESSENTIAL loads.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: No fuel budget ceiling or 30-day emergency reserve constraint exists in milp.py or system configs.

ai_proposed_position: Renewable energy served to load as fraction of total load served. Target 50–70% for polar-day months; no target for polar-night months.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: Specs contain qualitative goal 'maximize renewable integration'. No numerical 50-70% seasonal target or load-served KPI documented.

ai_proposed_position: Curtailment allowed freely without penalty to protect battery SOC or generator stability. Minimized when costless. Tracked, not penalized.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: milp.py leaves P_pv_curtail unpenalized in objective function, matching proposal's technical baseline.

ai_proposed_position: Dedicated Emergency Battery Reserve (EBR) of 35% SOC (normal) / 45% SOC (precautionary). Distinct from 20% technical minimum SOC floor.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: battery.yaml sets soc_min = 0.20 (technical minimum cell protection floor). 35% EBR and 45% precautionary SOC floors are unestablished.
numerical_values_proposed: 35% SOC (normal EBR), 45% SOC (precautionary EBR), ~20% (technical min SOC)

ai_proposed_position: Terminal SOC floor = EBR (35% min under normal conditions); precautionary target = 55–65% ahead of storms / polar night. Relaxed in active emergencies.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: milp.py has no terminal SOC constraint. 35% floor and 55-65% precautionary target are unestablished in current codebase.
numerical_values_proposed: 35% SOC (minimum terminal SOC), 55–65% SOC (precautionary terminal SOC)

ai_proposed_position: Conservative deterministic derate + receding-horizon re-optimization (every 1–6 hours). Derates: Solar 15–25%; Wind 20–30%; Demand +10%.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: Project review notes qualitative goal to mitigate solar forecast uncertainty. milp.py uses deterministic point forecast. Derate margins (15-25%, 20-30%, +10%) are unestablished.

ai_proposed_position: Reliability hard priority over fuel in normal/degraded modes; mode-based lexicographic shift in emergency. Rejects 16,000:1 ratio and ~0.3716 L/kWh V2 empirical ratio as policy coefficients.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: Stakeholder review confirms 16,000:1 is objective cost coefficient ratio ($10,000/kWh / $0.625/kWh) and ~0.3716 L/kWh is trajectory-dependent empirical V2 outcome, neither being policy.
numerical_values_proposed: 16,000:1 (implementation ratio reference), ~0.3716 L/kWh (V2 empirical ratio reference)

ai_proposed_position: 8-level hierarchy: 1. Safety -> 2. Critical Reliability -> 3. Equipment Protection -> 4. Emergency Resilience -> 5. Diesel Conservation -> 6. Renewables -> 7. Cost/Wear -> 8. Comfort.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: milp.py baseline uses single scalar composite objective function. 8-level hierarchy is unestablished in codebase.

ai_proposed_position: 6 distinct governance roles: Propose, Review, Validate, Approve, Emergency-Authorize, Record. 72-hour emergency reporting window.
current_polaris_evidence_summary: Stakeholder review notes absence of formal governance approval structure in project specs.
